hooks.command: echo '== Legend Project Context =='; cargo run --quiet -- get_state 2>/dev/null || echo 'Legend not initialized. Run: cargo run -- init'
echo '== Legend Memory =='; cargo run --quiet -- memory start --compact 2>/dev/null

changed=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | head -5); if [ -n "$changed" ]; then count=$(echo "$changed" | wc -l); echo "Legend: $count file(s) changed."; echo "Remember to tick: cargo run --quiet -- memory tick 'summary of work'"; fi
echo 'Reminder: Query memory for context on unfamiliar topics: cargo run --quiet -- memory query "topic"'
